definition: On the fixed-grip test evaluation episodes (IDs5..9), score stored pre-action cube_moving rows. At zero-based step t exactly min(t,K) completed same-episode transitions are available; history is incomplete iff t<K.
interpretation: These are input-availability counts, not evidence that the model forms a useful belief. Later error changes can reflect task phase even after history is full.
step_numbering: Zero-based stored step; plotted human step is stored step+1.
